notes: Shalya Parva close + Sauptika Parva — the night after the eighteenth day and the dawn after. The Pandavas, Krishna and Satyaki sleep away from camp by the Oghavati; Ashwatthama, Kripa and Kritavarma raid the sleeping camp. Family-friendly: the raid is told by implication only — no victims, bodies, gore or wounds are ever drawn. Bhima, Nakula, Sahadeva, Satyaki, Dhrishtadyumna, Shikhandi, Draupadi and her sons are narrated only, never drawn. Krishna = Ep 04 lock (official series reference): pale silvery dusty-blue skin, long loose curls, slim gold band with one peacock feather, white U-tilak, jasmine-rose garland, saffron-yellow pitambar dhoti, crimson sash, exactly two hands — away plate only. Yudhishthira, Arjuna = Ep 14/15 locks; Duryodhana and Ashwatthama = Ep 16 locks; Shiva = Ep 06 lock; Kripa and Kritavarma = new Ep 20 locks. One new scene master (camp20); lake20 = Ep 19 lake19 byte copy.

krishna.face: Youthful divine adult, serene dark eyes, gentle half-smile — the official series Krishna is the Ep 04 lock (episodes/04-akshayapatra/stills/_locks/krishna.jpg; Avinash 2026-10-05): pale silvery dusty-blue skin, white U-tilak on the brow
krishna.hair: Long loose dark curls under a slim gold band with one peacock feather (not a tall crown)
krishna.costume: Saffron-yellow pitambar dhoti, crimson sash, jasmine-and-rose flower garland, gold jewelry; exactly two hands; Arjuna's charioteer, on foot by the Oghavati river in this episode (away plate only) — never a flute, never a bow, never a child

yudhishthira.face: Eldest Pandava king, calm noble face, modest mustache, dharma in the eyes — distinct from Arjuna (Ep 14/15 lock)
yudhishthira.hair: Dark hair, simple gold diadem (lighter than Arjuna's heavy crown), no peacock feather
yudhishthira.costume: Cream-white royal dhoti and cream angavastram, gold sash, gold armlets — no gold chest armor, no Gandiva, no flower garland

arjuna.face: Noble adult warrior, dark mustache, steady dark eyes — Ep 09 face via the Ep 14/15 lock
arjuna.costume: Cream-white dhoti and angavastram, gold belt and armlets, quiver on back, Gandiva — never flower garland, never peacock feather

duryodhana.face: Adult Kaurava king, proud upswept mustache, fierce gaze (Ep 13 lock via Ep 16); here dying in peace at dawn, no wounds shown
duryodhana.hair: Dark hair; tall jeweled Kuru crown fallen on the sand beside him
duryodhana.costume: Jewel-tone gold Kaurava armor with saffron-orange cape, gold-decked mace at his side

ashwatthama.face: Young adult Brahmin-warrior, the guru's son: noble lean face, dark mustache, intense dark eyes; a luminous jewel (mani) in the middle of his forehead (Ep 15 lock via Ep 16); never a child, never white-bearded
ashwatthama.hair: Dark hair tied back under a slim bronze-gold warrior band (no royal crown, no peacock feather)
ashwatthama.costume: Deep maroon and bronze-gold engraved armor, white sacred thread across the chest, cream dhoti; great bow (owl, plan), Shiva's long shining sword (tent, fire, poster) — no saffron sage robes, no flower garland

kripa.face: Elderly Brahmin warrior, Kuru weapons-teacher: lean upright frame, grave lined face, close-trimmed silver-grey beard and mustache, three white ash lines on the brow (new Ep 20 lock) — clearly not Drona
kripa.hair: Silver-grey hair tied in a topknot; no crown
kripa.costume: Slate-grey and silver engraved armor over a cream dhoti, white sacred thread, a plain long bow — never saffron robes, never a long flowing white beard, no flower garland

kritavarma.face: Yadava chief of the Bhojas: mature, strongly built adult, square face, thick black mustache and short black beard, warm brown complexion (new Ep 20 lock) — never blue skin
kritavarma.hair: Dark steel helmet-crown with a small silver crest
kritavarma.costume: Blackened-steel and silver engraved armor over deep indigo cloth, sword at the hip — no peacock feather, no flute

shiva.face: Mahadeva as the guardian of the gate and the giver of the sword: pale blue-grey skin, calm stern face, vertical third-eye mark and three white ash lines on the brow (Ep 06 lock, byte copy) — clearly distinct from Krishna; fierce only through flame and scale, never fangs or skulls
shiva.hair: Long matted dark locks piled high with a silver crescent moon
shiva.costume: Tiger-skin garment, cobra coiled at the neck, rudraksha beads, golden trident; exactly two arms and two hands — never Krishna's peacock feather or saffron-yellow pitambar
